howto.what: 把WhatsApp Cloud通道装进NanoClaw,使其可收发一对一私聊。Claude会复制并注册WhatsApp适配器、安装固定版本依赖、跑构建和测试,并在3000端口启动webhook服务器;还需你事先在Meta后台填好四项应用凭据。
howto.when: 当用户要求接入WhatsApp Cloud API、正在/setup流程中需要该通道,或通过/manage-channels管理通道时触发。无需特定话术,明确要求即可。

say.note: Claude会开始复制适配器并装依赖。
路由和状态会迁移到新实例。

howto.what_en: Installs WhatsApp Cloud into NanoClaw for one-on-one messaging. Claude copies/registers the adapter, installs the pinned dependency, builds/tests, starts a webhook on port 3000; you must provide four Meta credentials.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to connect WhatsApp Cloud API, continue setup in /setup, or manage channels via /manage-channels. No special phrase required; just ask explicitly.

say_en.text: Add a WhatsApp Cloud channel to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: It will copy the adapter and install the dependency.

say_en.text: Follow add-whatsapp-cloud to connect Meta's WhatsApp API.
Upgrade my current WhatsApp channel to whatsapp-cloud.
say_en.note: Webhook route and state will migrate.
